title: City Fitness vs Snap
meta_desc: Compare City Fitness and Snap Fitness NZ prices, facilities, and value to choose the best gym for your needs, with prices from $7.99/week and 40-70% off with Exercise NZ subsidy
intro: City Fitness and Snap Fitness are two popular gym options in New Zealand, catering to different needs and budgets. City Fitness offers a budget-friendly option with prices starting from $7.99/week, while Snap Fitness provides a mid-range option with prices from $14.95/week. In this comparison, we'll help you decide which gym is best for you.

sections.heading: Overview of City Fitness and Snap Fitness
sections.body: Both City Fitness and Snap Fitness offer 24/7 access to their facilities, making them ideal for early birds and night owls. However, City Fitness provides a more comprehensive range of facilities, including group fitness classes, personal training, and an app, whereas Snap Fitness focuses on simple 24/7 gym access. City Fitness also has a more flexible contract option, with no lock-in contracts available, whereas Snap Fitness has a more traditional contract structure.
list: City Fitness: group fitness, personal training, app, guest passes, no lock-in contracts
Snap Fitness: personal training, app, 24/7 access

sections.heading: Price Comparison
sections.body: The prices of City Fitness and Snap Fitness vary significantly, with City Fitness offering a more affordable option. City Fitness prices start from $7.99/week, while Snap Fitness prices start from $14.95/week. Additionally, City Fitness has a one-off joining fee of $29, whereas Snap Fitness has a joining fee of $49, although this is often waived as part of promotions.

sections.heading: Facilities and Locations
sections.body: City Fitness has a more comprehensive range of facilities, including group fitness classes and personal training. However, Snap Fitness has a wider reach, with locations across New Zealand, including smaller towns. City Fitness, on the other hand, is only available in selected cities.
list: City Fitness: group fitness, personal training, app, guest passes
Snap Fitness: personal training, app, 24/7 access

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between City Fitness and Snap Fitness depends on your individual needs and priorities. If you're looking for a budget-friendly option with a comprehensive range of facilities, City Fitness is the better choice. However, if you prioritize simple 24/7 gym access and have a larger budget, Snap Fitness may be the better option. Additionally, eligible members can take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy, which offers 40-70% off gym memberships.
